import os, re

ROOT = "/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G011_halo/application/src/main/java"
SKIP = {"MoreRetries.java"}

pat = re.compile(
    r"Retry\.backoff\((\d+),\s*Duration\.ofMillis\(100\)\)\s*"
    r"\.filter\(\s*(?:OptimisticLockingFailureException\.class::isInstance"
    r"|\w+\s*->\s*\w+\s+instanceof\s+OptimisticLockingFailureException)\s*\)"
)
pkg_re = re.compile(r"^package\s+([\w.]+);", re.M)

total = 0
files = 0
for dirpath, _, names in os.walk(ROOT):
    for n in names:
        if not n.endswith(".java") or n in SKIP:
            continue
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, n)
        with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            src = f.read()
        new, cnt = pat.subn(r"MoreRetries.optimisticLock(\1)", src)
        if cnt == 0:
            continue
        pkg = pkg_re.search(new).group(1)
        if pkg != "run.halo.app.infra" and "import run.halo.app.infra.MoreRetries;" not in new:
            new = pkg_re.sub(lambda m: m.group(0) + "\nimport run.halo.app.infra.MoreRetries;", new, count=1)
        with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(new)
        total += cnt
        files += 1
        rel = p.replace(ROOT + "/run/halo/app/", "")
        print(f"{cnt}  {rel}")

print(f"\nTOTAL replacements: {total} across {files} files")
PYEOF
